Accuracy would hide poor results on rare emotions, so Macro F1 is used.
Lyrics beat audio for every model. Adding audio to lyrics gains only 0.01.
Valence overlaps across emotions, which suggests audio alone will struggle.
The best model finds 51–61% of each emotion, but most of its surprise guesses are wrong.
Similarity can help spot surprise songs, but not the other five emotions.
Note: Labels were generated from the lyrics by the model mrm8488/t5-base-finetuned-emotion, so models that use lyrics start with an advantage. Data: Kaggle, “500K+ Spotify Songs with Lyrics, Emotions & More”. Click any plot to enlarge.
